subject: general
question: Which is the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sicily**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sicily, **the biggest Mediterranean island, is located just off the **"toe"** of **Italy's "boot."**
 
• Its rich past is represented in places such as the Valley of the Temples, which has the well-preserved ruins of seven colossal Doric-style Greek temples, and the Byzantine mosaics at the Cappella Palatina, a former royal church in Palermo.
 
• **Mount Etna, Europe's tallest active volcano**, is located on Sicily's eastern border.
 
• The Mediterranean Sea is a sea connected to the Atlantic Ocean, encircled by the Mediterranean Basin, and almost totally surrounded by land: on the north by Western and Southern Europe and Anatolia, on the south by North Africa, and on the east by the Levant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Malta **is an archipelago in the central Mediterranean, located between Sicily and the coast of North Africa.
 
• **Crete **is the biggest and most populated of the Greek islands, ranking 88th in the globe and fifth in the Mediterranean Sea after Sicily, Sardinia, Cyprus, and Corsica.
 
• **Valletta (also Il-Belt) **is the capital of Malta, a Mediterranean island republic.
